findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House vote 66 to 47)
findings.note: Recorded Aye on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill requires county boards to process a voter registration application only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship (new G.S. 163-83), with a 30-day notice-and-sworn-statement step when the citizenship answer is blank. It also covers voter-list maintenance, including a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It has no photo-ID or mail-ballot-ID provision.

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, M11 Concur (House vote 62 to 47)
findings.note: Recorded Aye on the House vote to concur with the Senate changes to HB 958 (citizenship requirement on registration applications, voter-roll list maintenance, early-voting period changes). The bill summary page says the Governor vetoed it on August 17, 2026.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (final House passage vote, 6/30/2026 6:25 PM; 66 to 47)
findings.note: Campbell voted Aye. The bill, per the UNC bill summary, covers photo ID copies for overseas ballots, a later deadline to show ID after a provisional ballot, citizenship statements on registration, and absentee-ballot rules. The Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17.
